trust_decision.summary: Whether a request to change recurring-invoice state is a same-origin POST carrying a valid CSRF token is decided per action in the controller via Admin_Controller::ensure_valid_post_request(); CodeIgniter's global CSRF filter only covers POST, so GET actions without that call are unprotected.

landing_point.why: Summary names recurring-invoice state change via GET; Recurring::stop() is the only 'stop' action and the 65-line controller is read whole.

fix_sites.module_kind: view template (link converted to POST form with CSRF field; legit-behaviour counterpart, not a guard)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Recurring::delete() already sits behind a POST form with _csrf_field() in the view (application/modules/invoices/views/partial_invoices_recurring_table.php:49-51), so a solver can argue it is 'already CSRF-protected' and that the report is about stop only.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The Stop action in the recurring table must keep working from the UI: the GET link must become a POST form with the CSRF field, otherwise guarding the controller breaks the button; the same table is also re-rendered by the filter AJAX endpoint.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Recurring::delete() deletes a recurring-invoice schedule on any GET with no POST/CSRF check; only the view uses POST.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: View already submits it as a POST form with a CSRF field, and the advisory names only stop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'resume'/'pause' or 'update end date' controller action on recurring invoices reached by a GET link
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The model already has a stop() state mutator called directly from a controller; a maintainer adding a symmetric resume/pause would copy the original GET-link pattern of stop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An AJAX recurring-update endpoint in a different controller that accepts GET params
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: create_recurring already lives in Ajax.php, away from Recurring.php, giving a realistic distant second route into the recurring table.

O9_family: CSRF (CWE-352): state-changing action reachable by GET without token

O10_build.project_tests: No phpunit.xml at pinned commit; CI workflow prints 'No phpunit.xml found — no tests to run yet' (.github/workflows/phpunit.yml:80-83). No tests for this area.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add ensure_valid_post_request() to stop() only (and convert its link to a form), leaving delete() in the same controller accepting GET.
